If you're preparing for LeetCode in Java, you don't need every method in the Java API.
You need the methods that are commonly used in DSA.
1. String Methods ( java.lang.String )
Method
Description
Example
length()
Returns length
"abc".length() → 3
charAt(i)
Character at index
"abc".charAt(1) → 'b'

From index to end
"hello".substring(2) →
"llo"
substring(start,end)
Part of string
"hello".substring(1,4) →
"ell"
equals(str)
Compare strings
"abc".equals("abc")
equalsIgnoreCase(str)
Ignore case
"ABC".equalsIgnoreCase("abc"
)
compareTo(str)
Lexicographical comparison
"abc".compareTo("abd")
contains(str)
Check substring
